comparator.name: Chinese Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: Current annual 2026–2027 BA-CHI framework: year 1 55 compulsory + 5 bounded choice = 60 EC; year 2 25 compulsory + 15 content choices + 5 shared Asian-studies teaching + 15 Mandarin 2c = 60 EC. Ordinary Mandarin 2c abroad is one 15-EC component, not an extra overseas block; the Leiden shadow programme is conditional. No formal specialisations. Political economy and society choices are retained independently of UCR fit: Modern Chinese Economy and Development, Chinese Politics in the Era of AI, Sociology and Anthropology of Modern China and Japan in the 21st Century. In year 3, Mandarin 3a/3b total 10; one ordinary content seminar is 5; the other content seminar and BA Paper together are 10, not 5+10 (5683VBAWSY assessment). Genuine open space is 30. This independently supported subset totals 175 EC. The language-choice group is numerically 5 EC and one choice, but its semester instructions demand two 5-EC choices. Including one would close 180, including both would give 185 after correctly integrating the thesis. Neither interpretation is certified here. The previously stored 190-EC diagnostic double-counted the thesis-linked seminar. The formal OER Article 4.2 governs language and content prerequisites and propedeuse before thesis/overseas participation; Appendix F only replaces first-year units. It does not correct the language-choice conflict. Mentoring is a separately noted zero-credit activity. The public chart illustrates one language choice and integrated thesis, but retains replaced first-year titles and cannot establish precedence over the contradictory current guide. Permitted separate revisit on 2026-11-13: current BA-CHI and 28 module APIs were inspected; the same 5-EC/one-choice versus each-semester language conflict remains. Current OER Articles 2.2, 3.2.9, 4.2 and Appendix F were inspected through web retrieval; no applicable correction is supplied there. Direct formal/prospective downloads returned access-block HTML, which is not substantive source content. Use the inspected public programme overview as the reader-facing primary link; preserve the API and other sources internally.

components.name: Mandarin 2c in China or Taiwan
components.note: Ordinary required 15-EC language-training period in China/Taiwan. The Leiden alternative is a conditional shadow programme. Propedeuse and applicable cohort/departure conditions apply; the 2026–2027 module specifies cohort 2025–2026 and propedeuse before 1 February 2027, not a future cohort guarantee.

components.name: Chinese Labor Migration in Historical Perspective
components.note: One regular third-year content seminar, 5 EC; no formal admission condition. The other content seminar is integrated in the 10-EC BA Paper and is not counted separately.

components.name: BA Paper with linked content seminar
components.note: 10 EC in total for the linked China and the Global Political Economy seminar and BA Paper, replacing its ordinary 5-EC seminar assessment. Complete propedeuse required; a relevant BA2 content seminar is recommended and included. Programme permission and supervision registration required. No extra 5 EC is added.

components.name: Elective Space Bachelor
components.note: Genuine open elective space preserved from the official curriculum.

audience.programmeDescription: Chinese Studies at Leiden combines Mandarin and Classical Chinese with the study of China’s history, culture, politics, economy and society. Students develop language and research skills, normally spend a period studying Mandarin in China or Taiwan, and complete an independent paper linked to a third-year seminar. Elective choices allow a disciplinary emphasis; these are not separate formal specialisations.
audience.comparisonExplanation: A complete UCR comparison is not yet available because the official third-year language-choice requirements conflict. The supported curriculum is shown below. This uncertainty does not establish that UCR offers no suitable study possibilities.

curriculum.routeLabel: Chinese Studies; political economy and society choices
curriculum.limitation: The listed requirements total 175 EC and include 30 EC of elective space. A further language choice is required, but the official rules disagree about whether it is 5 EC overall or 5 EC in each semester. The paper and its linked seminar are counted together as 10 EC. This is an incomplete curriculum, not a certified 180-EC degree plan.

componentNotes.y2-mandarin-2c-abroad: One 15-EC language-training period in China or Taiwan. Participation requires the completed first year and the applicable cohort and departure conditions. A programme in Leiden is available only under specified circumstances.
componentNotes.y3-ba-paper: The linked seminar and independent paper together carry 10 EC. A completed first year, permission and supervision arrangements are required.
componentNotes.y3-elective-space: 30 EC of elective space, subject to Leiden’s requirements. The Chinese Economy and Society minor cannot be used because of overlap with compulsory study.
